{{Quote|But that is his ship. And where the ''Hawk-Bat'' ventures, Cohl is not far behind!|[[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] communications technician to [[Daultay Dofine/Legends|Daultay Dofine]]|<ref name="Cloak of Deception" />}}
The '''''Hawk-Bat''''' was a jet-black [[Tempest-class gunship|''Tempest''-class gunship]] famous for being the personal [[Starship/Legends|ship]] of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Arwen Cohl]], a famed [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] under the employ of the [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] group [[Nebula Front/Legends|Nebula Front]], and recognized as such on sight by many lowlifes throughout the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It led the [[Dorvalla Incident|attack]] on the ''[[Revenue]]'', a [[Lucrehulk-class LH-3210 cargo freighter/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class LH-3210 cargo freighter]] that belonged to the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], over [[Dorvalla/Legends|Dorvalla]]<ref name="Cloak of Deception" /> in [[33 BBY/Legends|32.5 BBY]].<ref name="tnec">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the events of ''[[Cloak of Deception]]'' in [[33 BBY/Legends|32.5 BBY]].</ref>

It was later commandeered by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Karfeddion/Legends|Karfeddion]], where he used it to travel to [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]].<ref name="Cloak of Deception" />
